ticket.subject: Locked out of admin account
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

I am the only admin on our workspace and I am locked out after too many failed two-factor codes.

The account recovery page sends me in a loop back to the 2FA screen.

It is affecting our work as we speak, so please look at it today. Can you help me get back in?

Many thanks,
Lars Szabo
support lead, Kettlewick Ltd

label_notes: clean access (access-locked-admin): a locked-out admin is P2 in the guide; urgency high: ongoing impact or a deadline within 24 h.
